source_text: Proponents of absolutism emphasize causal links between FGM and irreversible harms, rejecting medicalization as a false safeguard that sustains demand, while enforcement advocates call for enhanced surveillance of clinics and community reporting incentives to avoid underground proliferation without excusing the practice's persistence.
